reviews.title: Nice stealthy, non rgb build
reviews.comment: This case is really cool. Lots of different ways to configure the storage and space within. One complaint is not being able to fit as many fans as i thought. But it would be overkill anyway. 3 removable mesh filter trays, this version has the non see thru sides. I'm impressed by the manufacturing. Only other negative was some parts that are removable are really tough to get out. But the doors and filters come out with ease and snap in perfectly!
reviews.author: josh

reviews.title: Nearly perfect
reviews.comment: PROS: Extremely easy to build in well thought out case. Excellent airflow for water cooling in top and front. Fits 2x360mm radiators. Dust filters everywhere but the back. Available with a solid side panel, unlike most other high end cases. Sturdy, including the mesh parts. Came with 3 good 140mm 3-pin fans. CONS: Expensive.  Version without glass side or RGB should be under $150. Only 2 USB-A ports on the top.  There's space enough to add 2 more but Fractal chose not to. No front 5 1/4" or 3.5" bays to allow adding more front I/O. The rotated vertical GPU slots won't fit 3-slot GPUs. Other Thoughts: As close to perfect as I could hope for. This is ideal for water cooling.  If you're using air cooling, probably get the Fractal Torrent instead.
reviews.author: Noah

reviews.title: Best Airflow Case out There
reviews.comment: The best looking airflow catered case out there. Great quality and presentation of the product. Love all of the HDD bay and built in cable management. The fact that I had the flexibility to but a solid side panel and pay less was a huge reason I went with this case.
reviews.author: Pierson Allston

reviews.title: Best case for building a PC
reviews.comment: So much of the case is removable to allow easier access, excellent cable management tools right out of the box. It is minimalist and elegant, no cursed tempered glass. So happy with it!
reviews.author: Pj

reviews.title: Good air flow
reviews.comment: Great looking case, good airflow. Responsive customer service at Fractal when I needed to replace the headers.
